name: Ferry Salim
bio: Ferry Chandra Salim is a prominent Indonesian actor, model, and presenter known for his extensive work in film and television since 1996. He gained widespread recognition for his role in Ca-Bau-Kan and is also celebrated for his long-standing role as a UNICEF National Ambassador.
